subject: Request: pad demo window for APAC overlap & on-site travel setup
messages:
From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Green <samantha.green@finlytics.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 08:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Request: pad demo window for APAC overlap & on-site travel setup

Hi Samantha —

Thanks again for locking in the demo slot next week. One quick ask from our side: Marcus mentioned the team will be on-site for parts of the week, and a couple of our engineers (Priyom, Monica) will have travel constraints overlapping the scheduled time. To make the demo productive, could we add a 20–30 minute padding before the main demo for a technical dry-run and a short post-demo window for quick Q&A?

Specifically we want to: 
- run a 25-minute dry-run with sample traces and prompt sets to validate latency/throughput for your advertised workload
- confirm SSO / SAML access and any IP allowlist entries before the customer-facing portion
- walk through the sample-data mapping (we'll bring sample-trace-summary.csv)

If padding isn't possible for the original slot, happy to propose alternate times that give us an equal or better overlap with your APAC engineering team (we're sensitive to your on-site schedule). I attached the latest runbook and the sample trace summary for context.

Proposed options (PST/UTC shown):
- Keep current slot + add 25m pre-run and 15m post-run
- Shift 90 minutes earlier so our APAC engineer (Monica) can join live (alternatively we can record the dry-run)
- Move to the next day same time if that avoids travel conflicts

Let us know which works best and if Marcus or someone from your infra team can join the pre-run to approve networking changes.

Thanks,
Nikhil Sharma
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
nikhil.sharma@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0126

Attachments: redwood-demo-runbook-v2.pdf (15 pages), sample-trace-summary.csv (12KB)
From: Samantha Green <samantha.green@finlytics.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marcus Li <marcus.li@finlytics.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 17:40:00 +02:00
Subject: Re: Request: pad demo window for APAC overlap & on-site travel setup

Hi Nikhil —

Appreciate the heads-up and the runbook. We do need the extra padding: our infra lead (Marcus) will be travelling that morning and won't be available until later in the day, and several of our APAC engineers are on an onsite visit that week. Two quick asks from our side: 

1) Can the technical dry-run include a quick network-check script and our expected production token volumes? Marcus wants to confirm any egress IPs that need allowlisting.
2) Can you delay the customer-facing portion by 90 minutes so Marcus can dial in post-travel? If not feasible, we can nominate Tessa (APAC infra) to attend the pre-run but she'll need a 30-minute overlap with the demo.

If you can shift by 90 minutes later UTC, that should line up for us. Otherwise the next morning (Mon, 19 Apr) at the same time works. 

Thanks — I'll leave the scheduling details to you and Priyom.

Best,
Samantha Green
Head of Data Platform | FinLytics
samantha.green@finlytics.com

From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Samantha Green <samantha.green@finlytics.com>, Marcus Li <marcus.li@finlytics.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 18:05:00 +00:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: pad demo window for APAC overlap & on-site travel setup

Team — forwarding Samantha's reply. Short ask: can we shift the customer-facing portion 90 minutes later (FinLytics suggested) and run a 25-minute dry-run immediately before the public demo? Priyom, can you lead the dry-run and run the network-check script? Monica, can you confirm whether a 90-minute shift keeps you within your travel window, or if we should instead move to Mon 19th same time?

Operational checklist for the pre-run (quick):
- Priyom: run network-check.sh and verify egress ranges; confirm SSO flows (10m)
- Monica: validate sample-trace-summary.csv against expected token distribution (10m)
- Irene: keep the runbook open and be ready to toggle fallback model routing if latency spikes (5m)

I'll wait for a quick thumbs-up and then propose updated calendar times to Samantha and Marcus. If shifting the public demo is hard, we can do the dry-run earlier and record for Marcus, but I'd rather have him present for the routing/allowlist decision.

Thanks — Nikhil

> On Sun, Apr 18, 2027 at 17:40 +02:00 Samantha Green wrote:
> > Hi Nikhil —
> > ...
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Samantha Green <samantha.green@finlytics.com>, Marcus Li <marcus.li@finlytics.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 09:12:00 +00:00
Subject: Re: Request: pad demo window for APAC overlap & on-site travel setup

Thumbs-up from me — I can run the pre-run and execute network-check.sh. Quick notes: 
- network-check.sh will take ~7 minutes (DNS, port checks, egress IP probe). I'll attach the output to the meeting thread after the run.
- Monica: I skimmed sample-trace-summary.csv; token distribution looks moderately spiky at the 95th percentile. I recommend we reserve the 2x burst plan in the runbook for the first 5 minutes of the demo to avoid throttling during prompt waterfalling.
- Irene: happy to own the fallback routing toggle if latency crosses 450ms p95.

Based on availability I propose we move the public demo 90 minutes later on Apr 19 (same start time as originally scheduled but +90m) so Marcus can join after travel — Samantha, does Apr 19 +90m work for you? If yes we'll update the calendar and add a 25m pre-run (internal + Marcus) and a 15m post Q&A.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Senior Inference Engineer | Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwoodinference.com

Attachments after pre-run: network-check-output.txt (stub)
